name: lakutata-website
description: The website of the lakutata framework: the guides of packages/lakutata/doc, the READMEs of the packages and the API reference of the subpaths, built with VitePress.

scripts.dev: npm run content && vitepress dev src
scripts.build: npm run content && node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/vitepress/bin/vitepress.js build src
